title: Antigravity rule frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter schema for Antigravity rules (rules/<name>.md). Transcribed from https://antigravity.google/docs/rules/ on 2026-09-28; no JSON Schema is published for it. trigger is REQUIRED — an unrecognised value causes the rule to be silently discarded.

trigger.description: Controls how and when the rule activates.

description.description: Required for model_decision. Injected into the prompt index so the agent can decide whether to read the rule.

globs.description: Required for trigger: glob. Comma-separated file glob patterns, e.g. "*.py, *_test.py". Quote patterns starting with * so YAML does not read them as an alias anchor.
